thread:
Maya S.: Hey team — Saffron (fintech) just asked for an expedited bespoke rate. They want 40% off hosted API + a short Dedicated window for a 3-month integration POC. They claim they'll sign an LOI if we can move fast. Can deal desk and finance triage?
Carlos V.: Quick q — is the 40% on hosted usage only or across dedicated commit + API?
Maya S.: Across both. Proposal from customer: 40% off list for first 3 months, then revert to standard overage rates. They want data residency + SOC2 confirm.
Priya (DealDesk): 40% is large. Need ARR-equivalent or committed spend to justify. What committed $ or GPU hours will they guarantee?
Maya S.: They offered a 6k/mo guaranteed spend during the 3mo POC (so $18k total). They also want a 30% conversion discount if they go to dedicated after POC.
Dan F.: Margin check: at 40% we drop below pricing floor for hosted usage unless we layer in support credits / minimums. What's their expected tps/tokens?
Maya S.: Expecting ~8M tokens/mo gen + embeddings, some heavy reranking (short bursts). Worst-case we need 1 x a100 equivalent for dedicated bursts.
Lee S.: Pricing floor for hosted is 25% off without exec approval. Anything >30% needs VP signoff + finance & legal guardrails.
Priya (DealDesk): Suggest counter: 30% off hosted + dedicated at net 35% with a 6-month convert commitment OR 40% off hosted only if they sign a 6-month committed spend of >= $60k. That keeps margin safe.
Maya S.: Customer is time-boxed — they want a decision in 48h. They're sensitive to committed term length; 6 months may be a hard sell.
Jen L.: Legal flags: no permanent data deletion overrides, need SOC2 + contractual SLA language. If they're pushing 40% with special data clauses we need to see security questionnaire answers before pricing is finalized.
Carlos V.: Can we offer a middle ground: 35% passthrough for first 3 months, refundable pilot credit of $15k if they convert to a 12-month dedicated commit? Keeps the headline discount lower but gives them a runway.
Dan F.: Refundable credit sounds ok. If they convert, the $15k credit converts to a prepayment applied to first invoice. If they don't convert, it's consumed to cover cost. Approve on finance side pending usage cap.
Priya (DealDesk): I'll draft two options to present: A) 30% hosted + 35% dedicated with 6mo convert commit B) 35% hosted for 3mo + $15k refundable conversion credit (12mo convert). Need Maya to confirm which one Saffron prefers.
Maya S.: I'll run both options with them and push for option B (they like refundable credits).
olivia-bot: Deploy notification — pricing template v2.3 uploaded to /pricing-templates/sales.
Jen L.: Also require their legal contact and a signed DPA before we spin Dedicated. I'll include a minimal clause for pilot-only data retention and audit rights.
Lee S.: For record: any bespoke rate >30% requires VP Sales approval. @Priya we'll need your writeup for the approval packet (deal economics, counterfactuals, security signoffs).
Priya (DealDesk): On it — will attach margin calc + recommended fallback. ETA 4 hours.
Carlos V.: Thx — ping me when the packet is ready, I'll join the customer call to present.
Maya S.: Thanks team — I'll update thread after the call. Urgent but doable. :thumbsup:
